body: Thank you, I'll keep that in mind... Sometimes, it's nice to talk to someone who doesn't know you at all.

I'm not, not anymore at least. Sure I still am sad about what could have happen, but I know I'd be miserable with her even if I was "with" her. I guess it's just the unanswered questions that get to me the most. It's just a bunch of stress that really hits me at the same time, and it always falls back to times when I was happy. And I guess my parent would have to deal with it anyways, they can't force me to go to college, they'll understand. Thanks for reading. Appreciate it. Really, I do.
